description.value: Dodd Island is a backcountry island campsite in the Broken Group Islands unit of Pacific Rim National Park Reserve, reachable only by boat — a paddler's and sea-kayaker's destination set in a sheltered, wildlife-rich archipelago off Vancouver Island's west coast; no road access means cyclists must arrive by water, making it a logistical undertaking rather than a touring stop.
